messages.subject: ponytail #346 implement: 12/12 tasks, FINAL pass, archived
messages.body: 12 of 12 plan tasks are complete (T2, T5 and T9 went through the retry ladder; T9 took 4 attempts), and after a fresh FINAL pass the helper archived the package to .dev/tasks/done/TASK-WF-spec-20261108-181547. New tests: '123 passed in 7.58s'; keep-green spec-panel and routing tests: '1483 passed in 7.37s'; full suite after T8: '24 failed, 24643 passed, 150 skipped, 2 xpassed, 32 warnings, 16 errors', the same 40 failing ids as the baseline before any change; make lint: 'All checks passed!' rc=0. Not verified: whether a dispatched worker can load the ponytail plugin (an open smoke check in INSTALL.md) and the hash of the installed ~/.claude/commands/sc/spec-panel.md; known gap: Fix Audit item 4 of the variant and SKILL.md:37 claim a failure leaves the spec unchanged, but fix_audit.py writes apply-log.md and closed-minor.txt after the spec write with no handler, so a disk error at that point leaves the spec edited until current-before-audit.md is copied back.
